items.meaning: 元素弹跳着出现
items.ask: 让标志以弹性入场出现，时长约 0.4 s，略微超出目标尺寸后回弹。
items.use: Use it to bring in a small element such as an icon, button or badge with a light accent.
spec: One pop per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s cycle: a star on coral first, then a heart on blue).
Icon: 116 px rounded square (radius 30). From 0.28 s, scale 0→1 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(15t), peaking at about 1.26.
At the same time, rotation −0.35 rad (about −20°) → 0 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6t)·cos(11t).
Badge: yellow circle, radius 25, with "1", at the icon's top-right (+52, −52). Starts at 0.62 s with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(17t).
Exit: 1.86–2.12 s. Scale is multiplied by (1 − backIn, s = 2.2), so it swells slightly and then shrinks to 0.
Floor shadow: 62 × 8 ellipse that scales with the icon (clamped to 0–1).
items.aliases: 弹入 弹跳 弹出 蹦出来 弹性出现 图标弹出 蹦出 pop in

items.meaning: 多个元素错开时间依次出现
items.ask: 用交错动画让五张卡片从左到右依次入场，每张间隔 0.08 s。
items.use: Use it to bring in several items (list rows, chart bars, cards) in sequence and lead the eye across them.
spec: One pass per 2.35 s. Seven bars (width 44, gap 20, heights 52, 84, 68, 112, 92, 136, 158), coloured blue, coral, yellow, mint in rotation.
Bar i (0-based) starts at 0.15 + 0.12·i s and grows from 0 to full height in 0.5 s with backOut (s = 2.6), anchored at the baseline, overshooting and settling.
White dot (radius 6.5, 16 px above the bar top): starts 0.34 s after its bar with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(16t).
Exit: bars shrink with cubic ease-in over 0.26 s starting at 1.78 + 0.045·i s; dots vanish first, over 0.2 s from 1.70 + 0.045·i s.
items.aliases: 依次出现 逐个出现 错开 列表依次进场 依次浮现 一个个出现 stagger

items.meaning: 元素出现时向外迸出线条和圆点
items.ask: 爱心出现时加一次放射爆发：8 根短线在 0.3 s 内淡出。
items.use: Use it to mark the instant something is triggered or achieved, such as a like, a success or a correct answer.
spec: One burst per 2.35 s. A heart (size 46, 7 px outline) sits in the centre.
Anticipation: 0.3–0.5 s, scale 1→0.7 (quadratic ease-in-out).
Trigger at 0.5 s: the heart fills with coral and scale returns 0.7→1 with spring 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(16t).
Ring: yellow, radius 44→90 while line width goes 16→0, over 0.6 s with quintic ease-out.
10 radial lines (yellow/mint alternating, width 9): outer end radius 64→130 (y scaled 0.82); length 36 shrinks to 0 between 0.22 and 0.7 s after the trigger.
10 dots (coral/blue alternating, radius 8→4.8): radius 58→150 on an ellipse (x ×1.45, y ×0.78), fading out 0.3–0.72 s after the trigger. The heart fill fades at 1.92–2.2 s.
items.aliases: 迸发 爆发 放射 射线 放射线 炸开 线条迸出 散开

items.meaning: 线条像被画出来一样逐渐延伸
items.ask: 让图表曲线从左侧开始，在 1.2 s 内逐渐描绘出来。
items.use: Use it when the stroke itself is the point: charts, routes, underlines, hand-drawn circles.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Drawn as a trim path: animate the visible range (start fraction to end fraction) of each stroke.
Axes (L shape, width 6) draw at 0.08–0.7 s; the line (mint, width 11, a smooth curve through 7 points, round caps) draws at 0.4–1.95 s. Both use cubic ease-in-out.
While drawing, a yellow dot (radius 12, white centre radius 5) rides the leading tip.
Arrowhead: opens at 1.9–2.2 s with backOut (s = 2.5); wings 26 long, 20 wide.
A coral circle (radius 26, width 7) is drawn around one peak at 2.2–2.8 s, clockwise from the top.
Erase: circle 3.5–4.0 s, line 3.65–4.45 s, axes 3.85–4.55 s, each shrinking from its starting end. The arrowhead fades at 4.3–4.45 s.
items.aliases: 描边 画线 线条生长 手绘出现 勾勒 线条延伸 一笔画出

items.meaning: 文字从不可见的边界后移出
items.ask: 让标题从下方通过遮罩显现，时长 0.6 s，各行稍微错开。
items.use: Use it for titles and headings that should appear in a clean, composed way.
spec: One pass per 2.35 s. Divider line (coral, 380 × 6, y = 124): grows from the centre at 0.1–0.5 s (cubic ease-in-out), shrinks away at 2.05–2.3 s.
Top text (bold 98 px, white): clipped to the area above the line (y 8–119); moves up into place from 120 px below at 0.35–1.0 s, quintic ease-out.
Bottom text (32 px, yellow): clipped to the area below the line (y 129–181); moves down into place from 60 px above at 0.55–1.15 s, quintic ease-out.
Exit: top text moves 150 px up at 1.7–2.05 s (backIn, s = 1.2, dipping slightly first); bottom text moves 70 px down at 1.75–2.05 s (cubic ease-in).
Opacity never changes; the text is hidden only by leaving the clip area.
items.aliases: 蒙版 遮罩 滑出显现 遮罩擦除 文字滑入 从边后移出

items.meaning: 文字像打字一样逐字出现
items.ask: 给这句话添加打字机效果，每个字 0.05 s，末尾保留光标。
items.use: Use it to show someone typing: a prompt, a search query, a chat message.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Nine characters appear in a white input field (471 × 92, radius 30), one every 0.24 s starting at 0.3 s (typing ends at 2.46 s).
Each new character settles from scale 1.35 to 1: 1 + 0.35·e^(−16t).
Cursor (coral, 5 × 44) sits after the last character: solid while typing, otherwise blinking with a 0.94 s period (on for 0.5 s).
Send button (radius 30): grey, then a blue disc appears from 2.58 s with spring 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(15t).
Press: the button shrinks by up to 20% at 2.96–3.21 s (half sine). At 3.13–3.41 s the text moves 70 px up while fading out.
The cursor returns to the start once the text is half faded (about 3.27 s); at 3.51–3.81 s the blue fades.
items.aliases: 打字 逐字出现 打字机 一个字一个字 光标 字幕打出 文字跳出

items.meaning: 数字快速增长到目标值
items.ask: 用数字递增让数字在 1.5 s 内从 0 增长到 1,280，末尾减速。
items.use: Use it to make a figure feel big or growing: revenue, user counts, completion rates.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Fades in at 0.1–0.4 s and out at 4.0–4.4 s.
Number (bold 104 px): 0→2,480 over 0.45–2.9 s. Value = round(target × (1 − (1 − p)^4)): fast at first, slow at the end.
Thousands separator included. Every digit has the same width and the number is right-aligned, so it does not jitter sideways.
Lands at 2.9 s: colour switches white→yellow and scale does a small bounce, 1 + 0.07·e^(−7t)·cos(15t).
Up-arrow chip on the left (mint circle, radius 34): appears from 0.35 s with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(14t); while counting it shakes vertically by 6 px × (1 − p)^3 × sin(30u).
Bar below (330 × 12, blue→mint gradient): fills in proportion to value ÷ target.
items.aliases: 数字滚动 数字跳动 计数 数值增长 数据跳动 涨数字 count up

items.meaning: 文字随含义和节奏移动、缩放与旋转
items.ask: 把旁白做成动态排版，重读词放大，并对齐节拍出现。
items.use: Use it to make key words from narration or lyrics memorable through how they move.
spec: Four words, 1.175 s each (bold 88 px). Each exits in its last 0.2 s, fading out while moving 46 px up (cubic ease-in).
Stretch (blue): horizontal scale 0.3→1 with spring 1 − e^(−4.2t)·cos(12t); vertical scale is 1/√(horizontal).
Bounce (yellow): characters staggered by 0.1 s; height 78 px × |sin(πt/0.4)| × e^(−2.6t); squashed vertically by up to 16% at each contact.
Spin (mint): characters staggered by 0.12 s; rotation −360°→0° over 0.62 s with backOut (s = 1.3); scale 0→1 over 0.25 s, cubic ease-out.
Slam (coral, 100 px, slanted): scale 3.4→1 at 0.02–0.2 s with cubic ease-in.
After impact: horizontal shake 10 px × e^(−9t) × sin(38t), vertical squash 20% × e^(−11t), and 8 radial lines for 0.4 s.
items.aliases: 文字排版动画 字随节奏动 文字律动 字幕节奏 kinetic

items.meaning: 动作通过加减速变化而非匀速移动
items.ask: 为这段移动添加缓出，使其逐渐减速停下。
items.use: Use it on any move, scale or rotation so the motion accelerates and decelerates instead of looking mechanical.
spec: One round trip per 4.7 s. Two 62 px squares (radius 16) travel 316 px horizontally: out at 0.2–1.75 s (1.55 s), hold 0.8 s, back at 2.55–4.1 s.
Top (constant): linear motion; shape and colour never change.
Bottom (eased): cubic-bezier(.86, 0, .14, 1). Slow start, very fast middle, slow stop.
The bottom square stretches horizontally up to 1.5× and flattens to 0.8× in proportion to speed (speed ÷ 3.6, clamped to 0–1).
Behind it: 3 speed lines (up to 150 px × 0.8–1.25) and 4 ghost copies lagging 0.035 s each.
Each rail shows 12 dots marking positions at equal time intervals (evenly spaced on top, bunched at both ends below).
items.aliases: 缓入缓出 加减速 平滑 不生硬 柔和 ease

items.meaning: 越过目标后回到目标位置并停稳
items.ask: 给仪表指针加上过冲回弹：先超出目标约 10%，再回弹到位。
items.use: Use it to give an arriving element energy and a springy feel.
spec: One pass per 4.7 s. Semicircular gauge (radius 128, stroke 26). Target is 0.7 of the sweep (126° from the left end).
Starts at 0.25 s: value = 0.7 × (1 − e^(−4.6t)·cos(10.5t)). About 0.3 s later it is roughly 25% past the target, then it oscillates and settles on the target.
The part beyond the target is drawn in coral. A yellow tick marks the target.
The filled arc is a blue→mint gradient; the needle is white, width 9.
Return: from 3.7 s, value = 0.7 × e^(−7.5t)·cos(8.5t) back to 0 (dipping slightly below 0 before it stops).
items.aliases: 回弹 弹簧 超出回弹 弹一下 有弹性 过冲

items.meaning: 通过压扁和拉长表现弹性
items.ask: 给球落地时加上轻微的挤压与拉伸。
items.use: Use it to give a character or logo weight and softness.
spec: A round character, radius 37. One bounce per 1.175 s (four per 4.7 s), a 92 px parabola. It drifts ±150 px sideways on a sine wave over the cycle.
On the ground (first and last 10% of each bounce): vertical scale goes between 0.52 (moment of impact) and 1.28 (moment of leaving) on a quadratic curve.
In the air: vertical scale = 1 + 0.28 × s^3, where s is the time offset from the apex (0 at the apex, 1 at take-off and touchdown), so it is stretched where it moves fast.
Horizontal scale is always 1 ÷ vertical (volume is preserved). The transform is anchored at the feet.
The shadow gets smaller and thinner with height. Short yellow lines flick out left and right at each landing (for about 18% of a bounce).
items.aliases: 压扁 拉长 形变 弹性变形 squash stretch

items.meaning: 一种形状平滑变成另一种
items.ask: 用形状变形让圆形在 0.8 s 内变成星形，同时由蓝色变成黄色。
items.use: Use it to turn one icon or logo into another without a cut.
spec: Four shapes, 1.175 s each: circle → square with rounded-off corners → star → heart → back to circle. Base radius 64.
Each segment holds first, then morphs to the next shape between 0.62 s and 0.04 s before its end (0.58 s).
Every outline is stored as 240 points; points with the same index are linearly interpolated. Progress uses backOut (s = 1.6), so it overshoots slightly.
Colour: blue → coral → yellow → mint, blended with quadratic ease-in-out.
During the morph the scale swells by 1 + 0.07 × sin(π × progress).
Four dots below; the dot for the current shape is larger and coloured.
items.aliases: 变形 形变 图形变换 圆变方 平滑变形 morph

items.meaning: 形状像液体一样流动和融合
items.ask: 让标志以液态动效入场，由液滴汇聚成形。
items.use: Use it for an organic, soft look in logos, backgrounds and connecting moves.
spec: Lead circle (radius 44): moves 300 px right at 0.35–1.45 s with cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .2, 1), rising 34 px on a sine arc while moving; returns the same way at 2.7–3.8 s.
Seven circles follow the same path, each 0.065 s later, radius tapering 44→15, wobbling ±6 px vertically.
Even while it rests, three small circles (radius 15, 13, 11) move in and out between 34 and 64 px from it, twice per cycle.
Merged look: draw the circles in white → blur 9 px → threshold the alpha (soft only between 112 and 144) → fill what remains with colour.
Fill is a diagonal gradient mint → blue → violet (#7C5CFF), with a white elliptical highlight on the lead circle.
items.aliases: 液体 液态 流动 融化 果冻 流体 metaball

items.meaning: 运动物体身后留下逐渐淡去的轨迹
items.ask: 给飞行圆球添加五层逐渐淡出的拖尾。
items.use: Use it to show speed or a path: flying objects, cursors, points of light.
spec: A ball (coral, radius 25, white centre radius 11) traces a figure eight once per 4.7 s: x = 196·sin(a), y = 62·sin(2a), with a advancing at constant speed.
15 copies, each placed 0.105 rad (about 0.079 s) further back along the path.
Copy radius goes 22→6 and opacity is 0.9 × (1 − i/15) + 0.05, so older copies are smaller and fainter.
Copy colour runs coral → yellow → blue from newest to oldest.
Draw the oldest copy first and the ball itself last.
items.aliases: 拖尾 残影 拖影 运动模糊 尾迹 拉丝

items.meaning: 大量小碎片喷出并散开
items.ask: 成功时从底部喷出四种颜色的粒子，在 1.5 s 内全部落下。
items.use: Use it to add celebration or liveliness, in place of confetti or sparks.
spec: 84 particles, emitted from the bottom centre (horizontal centre, 20 px above the bottom edge).
Initial velocity: ±190 px/s horizontally, 250–400 px/s upward. Gravity 470 px/s² (parabolic paths).
Each particle repeats with a period of 2.35 s or about 1.57 s, with a random start offset (fixed seed, so every run looks the same).
Lifetime up to 1.5 s: fade in over the first 0.06 s, fade out over the last 30%. Scale 1.15→0.7.
Shapes are circles, squares and triangles (size 5–11 px) in blue, coral, yellow and mint, spinning at up to ±4.5 rad/s.
items.aliases: 粒子 碎片 喷发 星火 光点 散开 飞溅

items.meaning: 远近图层以不同速度移动形成纵深
items.ask: 把风景拆成三层，近层滚动更快，形成视差。
items.use: Use it to give flat artwork or photos depth: backgrounds, landscapes, scrolling scenes.
spec: Camera pan: ±108 px on a sine wave, one round trip per 4.7 s.
Each layer is offset by pan × factor in the opposite direction. Factors from back to front: stars 0.05, moon 0.1, far ridge 0.28, middle ridge 0.6, front hill and trees 1.25, nearest dark shapes 2.1.
Far layers use darker colours close to the background, nearer layers brighter ones; the nearest layer is a large dark silhouette along the bottom.
Every layer is drawn at least 200 px beyond both sides of the frame so its ends never show.
items.aliases: 视差 分层移动 背景慢 纵深 立体移动 parallax

items.meaning: 扩大的形状内部显现下一场景
items.ask: 用遮罩转场切换场景，让圆从中心在 0.7 s 内扩展开。
items.use: Use it to change scenes starting from an object in the frame, such as a sun, logo or button.
spec: Day scene → night scene → day scene, 2.35 s each. The change runs at 0.45–1.6 s of each half (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out.
The next scene is drawn on top of the current one, clipped to a shape; the shape grows until it covers the frame.
Day→night: a circle from the sun's centre (112, 104), radius 0→470.
Night→day: a five-point star from the moon's centre (427, 104), outer radius 0→1150, rotating 1.2 rad (about 69°) as it grows.
While it grows, the edge of the shape has a white outline (width 7).
items.aliases: 圆形放大转场 遮罩转场 放大揭示 圆形擦除 圆孔打开

items.meaning: 图形覆盖画面后揭示下一场景
items.ask: 用四条斜向色带从左侧扫入，完成图形转场。
items.use: Use it to change scenes with shapes in brand colours: chapter breaks, topic changes.
spec: Day → night → day, 2.35 s each. Four horizontal bands (height 52; blue, coral, yellow, mint) whose ends are slanted by 80 px.
Cover: 0.38–1.0 s. Each band's leading edge travels from one side of the frame to the other. Bands are delayed by 14% of the phase each, and each uses cubic ease-in-out over 58% of the phase.
At 1.0 s, when everything is covered, the scene underneath is swapped for the next one.
Uncover: 1.12–1.75 s. Each band's trailing edge follows with the same delays and curve, exposing the next scene.
Direction: left to right for day→night, mirrored for night→day.
items.aliases: 图形覆盖 色块转场 形状擦除 图形擦除

items.meaning: 液体流入画面并替换场景
items.ask: 用蓝色墨水从顶部滴落铺满画面，完成液态转场。
items.use: Use it for a soft, organic scene change, for example in food, beauty or creative videos.
spec: Day → night → day, 2.35 s each. Two liquid layers, both moving top to bottom with quadratic ease-in-out.
Layer 1 (flat colour: blue for day→night, coral for night→day): 0.35–1.5 s. Layer 2 (the next scene itself, clipped to the liquid shape): 0.7–1.8 s.
The liquid front moves from y = −110 to 130 px below the bottom edge. Its edge waves with two sine waves (amplitudes 13 px and 8 px), strongest midway.
Seven drips (30–54 px wide, round tips) hang from the front; length = base 30–110 px × (0.25 + 0.9 × wave strength), greatest midway.
Merged look: draw the shape in white → blur 7 px → threshold the alpha → fill with the colour (or the next scene).
items.aliases: 液体流动转场 融化转场 液态过渡 流体擦除

items.meaning: 放大并穿过物体进入下一场景
items.ask: 用穿越缩放加速穿过标志中字母 O 的孔洞，进入下一场景，时长 0.6 s。
items.use: Use it to dive into a logo or letter and move to the next scene with momentum.
spec: Scene X (ZOOM on yellow) → scene Y (GO! on blue) → scene X, 2.35 s each.
The current scene is scaled around the centre of an O's hole (radius 24.5). Maximum scale is 1.08× the value at which the hole covers the whole frame (about 14×).
Scale = maxScale^p (exponential zoom, which reads as constant speed).
p = 0.8 × cubic ease-in (0.25–1.2 s) + 0.2 × cubic ease-out (1.2–1.65 s): accelerate in, slow down at the end.
Inside the hole the next scene is placed at 1/maxScale. When the zoom ends it is exactly at full size, and the view switches to the next scene.
items.aliases: 穿越 放大穿越 穿过物体 无限缩放 钻进去 zoom through

items.meaning: 像卡片翻面一样展示另一侧
items.ask: 让价格卡片在 0.5 s 内翻转，展示背面的详情。
items.use: Use it for two things that are sides of one another: question and answer, before and after.
spec: A card (300 × 156, radius 22). Front (blue, Q) ⇄ back (yellow, A), 2.35 s each.
Rotates 180° at 0.45–1.5 s (1.05 s) with backOut (s = 1.5), going slightly past 180° and coming back.
Card width = original width × |cos θ|. The face artwork is swapped as it passes 90°.
Perspective: the card is drawn in thin vertical slices whose height varies by up to ±20% × sin θ from one side to the other (far side shorter, near side taller).
During the turn it scales up 8% and lifts 6 px on a sine curve; a dark overlay with opacity 0.34 × |sin θ| shades the face. An elliptical shadow sits on the floor.
items.aliases: 翻面 翻转 卡片翻转 翻牌 翻过来

items.meaning: 光带扫过物体表面
items.ask: 标志停稳后，让一道柔和扫光从左上移到右下。
items.use: Use it to give a logo, badge or button a premium finish.
spec: One sweep per 2.35 s. The light is drawn only inside a clip of the badge (400 × 112, radius 28, blue gradient).
Light band: a 116 px wide white gradient (opacity 0.72 in the middle, 0 at the edges) plus a thin 12 px band (opacity 0.5) 78 px away, rotated 0.42 rad (about 24°).
It moves from 130 px left of the badge to 130 px right of it (660 px) at 0.45–1.5 s, quadratic ease-in-out.
Sparkle: a four-point star at the top-right corner at 1.38–1.98 s; size 30 × sin(πq) × (1 + 0.2(1 − q)), rotating 0.9 rad.
The badge itself does not move.
items.aliases: 扫光 光带 高光扫过 反光 光泽扫过 发光 流光

items.meaning: 画面像发生故障一样错位和分色
items.ask: 给标题添加 0.3 s 的轻微故障效果，少量分色，不要闪屏。
items.use: Use it for a digital, error or uneasy feel, as an accent on titles and scene changes.
spec: White bold text (104 px). It glitches twice per 4.7 s: 0.55–1.25 s (5 steps) and 2.9–3.74 s (6 steps); otherwise it is still.
Each step lasts 0.14 s and shows one fixed disturbance (stepped, not smoothly animated).
Colour split: a coral copy shifted 7–16 px left and 2 px down, a cyan (#22D3EE) copy shifted the same amount right and 2 px up, with the white text on top.
Slice shift: 2–4 horizontal strips (10–35 px tall, y 40–150) are displaced 18–64 px to the left or right.
Three small colour bars (coral, cyan, yellow; 30–120 wide × 5–12 tall) at random positions.
Background brightness never changes (no full-frame flashing). The random values use a fixed seed.
items.aliases: 故障 花屏 抖动错位 信号干扰 赛博故障 撕裂 glitch

items.meaning: 物体落下时带动整个画面震动
items.ask: 标题落地时添加冲击震动，在 0.4 s 内停稳。
items.use: Use it to land an important headline or number with weight and force.
spec: One drop per 2.35 s (a yellow slab first, then a coral one). The slab is 250 × 100, radius 18.
Fall: 0.3–0.62 s from above the frame to the floor, cubic ease-in (accelerating). While falling it is stretched 1.12× vertically.
Lands at 0.62 s. The whole frame shakes for 1.1 s: x 15 px × e^(−5t) × sin(2π·5t), y 11 px × e^(−5t) × cos(2π·6.5t), rotation 0.02 rad × e^(−5t) × sin(2π·5t + 0.6).
For 0.3 s after landing the slab squashes vertically by up to 22% and recovers (it widens by the same amount; anchored at its base).
Four background blocks hop up to 24 px, 0.03–0.06 s late, over 0.5 s. Six white lines and six dust puffs spread from the floor and fade within 0.55 s.
Exit: the slab moves 300 px up at 1.85–2.2 s (backIn, s = 1.6).
items.aliases: 震动 冲击 摇晃 撞地 屏幕抖动 地震 shake

items.meaning: 机位固定，向左或右转动镜头
items.ask: 固定机位，用 5 s 从左向右缓慢摇摄城市天际线。
items.use: To reveal a wide location or to shift attention from one side of the scene to the other.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); yaw only, -0.32 rad → +0.32 rad (-18° → +18°, about 37° in total)
Timing: rotate from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person (about 1.8 m tall) stands still 8 m ahead and slides right-to-left in frame
No parallax: mountains, buildings, trees and the person all shift by the same angle (focal length 330 px on a 539×208 card)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle in whole degrees (-18° → +18°)
items.aliases: 摇镜 摇 横摇 左右摇 平摇 左右转 pan

items.meaning: 机位固定，向上或下转动镜头
items.ask: 从人物脚边缓慢向上摇镜头，直到塔顶。
items.use: To show the height or scale of a building or a person.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.4 m); pitch only, -0.06 rad → +0.36 rad (-3° → +21°, about 24° in total)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; a 9.5 m tower (antenna tip at 11.8 m) stands 26 m away behind
On screen everything slides downward: the person leaves at the bottom while the tower top and its antenna enter
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle in whole degrees (-3° → +21°)
items.aliases: 上下摇 竖摇 仰俯 上下转 tilt

items.meaning: 相机整体向主体靠近
items.ask: 缓慢推镜头靠近她的脸，移动相机，不要变焦。
items.use: To move in on a person or detail while keeping a sense of depth.
spec: Camera: moves forward (in depth) 0 m → 5.8 m; height 1.5 m, direction and focal length (330 px, shown as 24mm) fixed
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 8 m ahead; distance goes 8 m → 2.2 m, so they appear about 3.6× larger
Parallax: a foreground post (1.5 m left, 3.6 m deep) and a rock (1.6 m right, 4.8 m deep) pass out of frame; mountains 120 m+ away stay almost the same size
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
The top-right readout stays at 24mm (the difference from 04 Zoom in)
items.aliases: 推 推近 推镜 前推 靠近 推过去 镜头前进

items.meaning: 相机不动，通过镜头变焦放大
items.ask: 相机保持不动，用 3 s 变焦推近窗边的人物。
items.use: To direct attention to one point without moving the camera; it looks flatter and more observational than a dolly in.
spec: Camera: position and direction fixed (height 1.5 m); only the focal length changes, 330 px → 1200 px (shown as 24mm → 87mm, about 3.6×)
Exponential interpolation: f = 330 × (8/2.2)^p, where p is a cubic ease-in-out from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s)
Subject: a person stands still 8 m ahead; the final size matches 03 Dolly in (about 3.6×)
No parallax: the foreground post and rock, the person, buildings and mountains all scale by the same ratio (overlaps do not change)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the focal length in mm (24mm → 87mm)
items.aliases: 变焦 拉近 镜头拉近 放大推近 焦距拉近 zoom

items.meaning: 相机随主体一起移动
items.ask: 从正侧方跟拍行走的人物，相机与人物同速移动。
items.use: To follow a walking or running subject and keep the sense of movement while showing their action.
spec: Camera: moves right at a constant 1.7 m/s (x = -4.0 m → +4.0 m in 4.7 s); height 1.3 m, facing straight ahead; no easing
Subject: a person walks at the same x as the camera (7.5 m away) and stays in the centre of frame; legs and arms swing by sin(u×7)×0.42 rad
Parallax: posts every 1.6 m at 4 m depth sweep left fastest, then trees, then buildings (48 m away); mountains hardly move
Top-right readout shows "→ 1.7m/s"
Repeat: jumps back to the start every 4.7 s (posts and ground grid line up at the seam; background buildings and trees jump)
items.aliases: 跟随 跟着走 跟镜头 追着拍 跟拍 tracking

items.meaning: 相机绕主体移动
items.ask: 用环绕镜头绕静立的人物拍摄半圈，始终保持人物居中。
items.use: To show a person or product in three dimensions, or to emphasise an entrance or a key moment.
spec: Camera: travels on a circle of radius 6 m centred on the person (9 m ahead), from -0.95 rad → +0.95 rad (-54° → +54°, about 109° in total)
Direction: always faces the centre (yaw = -angle); height 1.7 m, pitch fixed at -0.07 rad (about 4° down)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move; a white dot on the face shifts sideways with the angle; a dashed circle of radius 1.3 m marks the ground
Background: 12 trees evenly spaced on a 10 m radius cross behind the person as the camera moves round
Return: hold 3.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the angle (-54° → +54°)
items.aliases: 环绕 转圈拍 绕圈 360环绕 围绕 orbit

items.meaning: 相机整体向上升起
items.ask: 让相机从人物眼睛高度升起，直到看见整座城镇。
items.use: To pull away from a person at the end of a scene or to reveal how large the location is.
spec: Camera: rises from 1.4 m to 9 m while moving forward 0 m → 1.5 m
Direction: tilts down to keep the person (8 m ahead) in frame; pitch = -0.86 × atan2(height - 1.0, 8 - forward), about -2.5° → -44°
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move; they get smaller as the camera rises, the ground grid fills the frame and the horizon leaves at the top
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the height (↑ 1.4m → ↑ 9.0m)
items.aliases: 升起 上升 升镜 抬高 抬高机位 吊臂 crane up

items.meaning: 主体大小不变，背景发生透视变化
items.ask: 在人物顿悟时做滑动变焦：保持脸的大小，让背景拉远。
items.use: For a moment of realisation, or to show unease or shock visually.
spec: Camera: distance d to the person (8 m ahead) widens from 3.2 m → 8 m (a 4.8 m pull-back); height 1.3 m
Focal length: f = 330 × d/8 px, i.e. 132 px → 330 px (shown as 10mm → 24mm), keeping distance ÷ focal length constant
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: the person does not move and keeps the same height in frame; blue dashed lines 160 px wide at head (1.8 m) and feet show the size is constant
Background: buildings (48 m away) grow about 2.2× and mountains about 2.4×, closing in behind the person, while the ground in front of the person shrinks
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
items.aliases: 希区柯克变焦 变焦推拉 眩晕变焦 滑动变焦 背景拉伸 dolly zoom

items.meaning: 在近处与远处之间切换对焦
items.ask: 用 1 s 将焦点从前景杯子转移到后方人物。
items.use: To move attention from foreground to background (or back) without cutting.
spec: Camera: position, direction and focal length all fixed (height 1.1 m); only the blur amounts change
Blur: the foreground flower (0.75 m left, 2 m away) goes 0 px → 7 px; the person and background (person 0.9 m right, 9 m away) go 6 px → 0 px; the ground grid uses 0.6× the background blur
Timing: 1.0 s to 2.6 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Focus marker: blue corner brackets travel in a straight line from the flower to the person, half-width shrinking 46 px → 30 px
Subject: neither the flower nor the person moves
Return: hold 2.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows focus distance (◎ 2m → ◎ 9m)
items.aliases: 对焦 虚实转换 焦移 换焦 变清晰 焦点虚实 rack focus

items.meaning: 像手持相机一样轻微晃动
items.ask: 从后方手持跟拍步行人物，只保留轻微晃动。
items.use: To give a documentary feel or the sense of being present in the scene.
spec: Camera: position almost fixed; yaw, pitch, roll and height each get a sum of sine waves with different periods (T = 2π×u/4.7)
Yaw (rad) = 0.016·sin(3T) + 0.008·sin(7T+1) + 0.004·sin(13T+2), at most about ±1.6°
Roll (rad) = 0.02·sin(5T+1) + 0.008·sin(11T+3), at most about ±1.6°; height = 1.5 + 0.03·sin(6T) m
Subject: a person stands still 6.5 m ahead; the shake runs continuously with no easing or hold
All multipliers are integers, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s; top-right readout shows "HANDHELD"
items.aliases: 手持 晃动 手抖 真实感 晃动感 呼吸感 handheld

items.meaning: 以第一人称快速穿越场景
items.ask: 用 FPV 穿越机镜头从树林间穿过，飞向河面。
items.use: For speed and immersion, or to fly through a location in one continuous move.
spec: Camera: flies forward at a constant 14 m/s (shown as 50km/h) with no easing; pitch fixed at -0.05 rad
Weave (T = 2π×u/4.7, two swings per 4.7 s): sideways 0.6·sin(2T-0.4) m, height 1.4 + 0.5·sin(2T) m
Bank: roll 0.22·sin(2T+0.6) rad (about ±12.6°), yaw 0.05·sin(2T) rad (about ±2.9°)
No subject. Trees 4.2 m tall stand 3.6 m to each side, every 8 m, the two rows offset by 4 m, and rush toward the camera
Speed lines: 10 radial strokes about 32–76 px long (longer toward the sides) in translucent grey, flowing outward and recycling
No hold and no cross-fade reset (the tree rows shift phase when it restarts every 4.7 s)
items.aliases: 穿越机 第一人称飞行 航拍穿越 极速穿行 无人机 FPV

items.meaning: 倾斜相机，使地平线呈对角线
items.ask: 给这个不安的场景使用约 15° 的荷兰角。
items.use: To express unease, tension or the feeling that something is wrong.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); roll only, 0 → 0.36 rad (about 21°); the whole picture turns around the frame centre
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; horizon, buildings and person all tilt by the same angle
Hold: stays tilted from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (time to read the tilted composition itself)
Return: cross-fade back to the level start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle (∠ 0° → ∠ 21°)
items.aliases: 倾斜构图 歪斜 斜地平线 斜角 荷兰角 dutch

items.meaning: 放慢动作的播放速度
items.ask: 用慢动作展示水花溅起的瞬间。
items.use: To let viewers study a brief action or expression, or to emphasise an emotional peak.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); only the subject moves
Subject: a person 7 m away takes 3.8 s for one jump (0.5 s to 4.3 s); height = 4q(1-q)×1.1 m, a parabola peaking at 1.1 m, with q linear in time
Both arms are raised while airborne; the person stands still for 0.5 s before the jump and 0.4 s after landing
Leaves: 9 leaves fall from 3.4 m to the ground over 4.7 s while rotating, each offset by 1/9 of the cycle
Top-right readout shows "120fps ×0.25" (playback stretched 4×)
No hold and no cross-fade; loops seamlessly every 4.7 s
items.aliases: 慢放 慢镜 升格 减速 慢速 慢动作

items.meaning: 在同一镜头中改变播放速度
items.ask: 给跳跃加速度渐变：先正常速度，到最高点放慢，再恢复正常。
items.use: To slow down only the key part of an action while keeping the lead-in quick.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); only the playback speed changes
Playback speed: 2.4× → 0.25×; the change takes 0.7 s (1.2 s to 1.9 s) with a quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1))
Subject: a person 8 m away runs from 6 m left toward the right; x = -6 + footage time × 2.0 m; they close in quickly during the fast section
Jump: a parabola while x is between -1.5 m and 2.5 m, peak 0.99 m, arms raised; take-off at about 0.94 s, most of the airtime plays in slow motion, landing at about 3.68 s
Graph: a 120×40 px speed curve at bottom left with a blue dot (radius 5 px) at the current time
Return: stops at 4.2 s, then cross-fades back over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the rate (×2.4 → ×0.3)
items.aliases: 变速 快慢变化 速度渐变 加速减速 慢转快 speed ramp

items.meaning: 把数小时压缩成几秒
items.ask: 用延时摄影展示城市从黄昏到夜晚亮灯的过程。
items.use: To show a long stretch of time, or how a city, sky or task changes, in a short clip.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.6 m, pitch +0.08 rad, about 5° up)
Timing: 12 hours pass in 3.7 s (0.4 s to 4.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Sun: travels left to right along an arc, angle a = -1.25 rad → +1.25 rad; position (sin a×120, cos a×60 - 8) m at 170 m depth
Three clouds drift 140 m to the right in total, wrapping every 80 m; seven small figures each cross an 18 m width 6 times (odd and even ones in opposite directions)
Building shadows fall away from the sun and swing as it moves (translucent grey)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; the top-right clock runs 06:00 → 18:00 in 10-minute steps
items.aliases: 延时 快进 时间流逝 云流动 timelapse

items.meaning: 让动作暂停片刻
items.ask: 她转身时定格 1 s，并显示姓名。
items.use: To emphasise a decisive moment, or to pause so a name or caption can be placed over the frame.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.3 m); what stops is the footage time
Freeze: stops at 1.6 s and resumes at 3.0 s (1.4 s); footage time runs normally for 0–1.6 s, stays at 1.6 s while frozen, then continues as u-1.4
Subject: the jump of a person 7 m away is a parabola over footage time 0.6–2.6 s, peak 1.1 m; the freeze lands exactly on the peak (50% through)
Nine falling leaves also stop during the freeze; they fall 1.5× as fast as in 13 Slow motion
Freeze markers: a 5 px blue border and a pause icon at bottom centre (two blue bars on a 68×40 px white rounded box), fading in and out over 0.12 s
Top-right readout shows "FREEZE" only while frozen; no cross-fade reset
items.aliases: 定格 卡住 冻结 暂停 静止 freeze

items.meaning: 构图不变，跳过一段时间
items.ask: 用相同构图的跳切快速略过准备过程。
items.use: To tighten pauses in talk or work and raise the pace, or to show time passing quickly.
spec: Join: a straight cut with no effect (0 frames); 5 shots of 0.94 s each (4.7 s ÷ 5)
Camera: identical position and framing in every shot (height 1.4 m, facing forward); the background does not move by a pixel
What changes: the person (7 m away) jumps in sideways position, -2.2 m → 1.4 m → -0.4 m → 2.4 m → 0.6 m; in shots 2 and 4 both arms are raised
Within each shot the person is still (the jump is shown only by the difference in position and pose)
Top-right clock: 10:02 → 10:17 → 10:41 → 11:06 → 11:30, showing that time was skipped in the same place
Shot 5 cuts straight back to shot 1
items.aliases: 跳剪 跳切 直接切 突然跳 省略 jump cut

items.meaning: 利用相似形状或动作衔接镜头
items.ask: 从圆咖啡杯匹配剪辑到相同位置的满月。
items.use: To link two scenes far apart in time or place through a shared shape or motion.
spec: Join: a straight cut at 2.3 s (0 frames); the blue circle has the same position (120 px right, 46 px above centre) and radius 17 px on both sides
Outgoing shot (0–2.3 s): fixed camera (height 1.4 m); a person (1.2 m left, 7 m away) throws a ball from 0.5 s, cubic ease-out (about cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1))
Ball: travels from above the person's head (2.3 m high) to the match point; radius 5 px → 17 px, on an arc bulging up to 30 px
Incoming shot (2.3–4.7 s): a different place (no buildings, height 1.2 m); the blue circle in the same spot is now the sun and sinks 14 px over 2.4 s
Marker: a blue dashed circle of radius 26 px fades in and out within 0.7 s either side of the cut
Top-right readout shows "SHOT 1" → "SHOT 2"; at 4.7 s it cuts straight back to SHOT 1
items.aliases: 相似衔接 同形状衔接 图形匹配 无缝转换 match cut

items.meaning: 快速横摇形成模糊并切入下一镜头
items.ask: 向右甩镜头，落到下一个地点。
items.use: To change location or topic while keeping the energy up.
spec: Join: 0.8 s, from 1.7 s to 2.5 s; in the first 0.4 s the outgoing shot swings away, in the last 0.4 s the incoming shot swings in and settles
First half: outgoing yaw 0 → +0.45 rad (about 26°), quadratic ease-in-out; second half: incoming yaw -0.45 rad → 0, same easing
Swap: a straight replacement at the 50% point, hidden because the blur is at its strongest
Blur: 9 renders spread over ±1.6 frames (at 30 fps) are averaged
Camera: height 1.4 m, fixed except during the swing; the subjects (a person in A, a car and city in B) do not move

spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four steps ("Details, Review, Payment, Done" in Japanese) at x 80, 207, 334, 461, y 35; circles of radius 17 joined by a 4 px grey line.
The cursor clicks "Next" (110×38, bottom right) at 0.9, 1.7 and 2.5 s.
On each click the current step becomes a blue circle with a white check and the next becomes the current one (blue circle, white number). Steps not reached are white with a grey rim.
The blue line grows 127 px per click over 0.3 s with easeInOutCubic; after the third click all four are checked.
Reset: the indicator fades out over 3.75–4.05 s and fades back in at step 1 over 4.05–4.3 s.

spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A two-row list (a 96×56 picture and three text lines each). The cursor clicks the reload icon at top right at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) the content switches to grey #e9e7e5 rounded blocks of the same size and position.
Shine: a white band 160 wide (transparent at the edges, opacity 0.75 in the middle) sweeps from x −200 to x 742 every 0.9 s, drawn only over the blocks.

spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks "Send" (120×40, bottom centre) at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) a white scrim (opacity 0.78) and the spinner fade in over the whole card.
Spinner at (271, 92): a pale ring, radius 26, 6 thick, with a blue 243° (1.35π) arc on top (round caps), turning 1.3 times per second (468°/s).
Over 2.95–3.05 s the spinner fades; over 2.95–3.2 s a blue circle (radius 28) with a white check scales 0.7 → 1 (easeOutCubic).

spec: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 54-tall header with a line-drawn bell at (482, 27) on the right.
Badge: a blue circle of radius 12 at the bell's top right (+12, −12), 2.5 px white rim, white 14 px number.
Notifications arrive at 0.7, 1.3 and 1.9 s: the count goes 1 → 2 → 3. The first scales in over 0.7–0.9 s with easeOutCubic.
Each arrival pops the scale from 1.3 back to 1 over 0.3 s and sends out a ripple ring (radius 12 → 28, opacity 0.5 → 0) over 0.5 s.
The cursor reaches the bell at 2.95 s and clicks at 3.0 s; the badge shrinks to 0 over 3.0–3.25 s with easeInOutCubic.

items.use: Use it for first-use screens or no-results pages to tell people what to do next.

The cursor clicks the trash icons at 0.95 s and 1.65 s. Each row slides 60 px left while fading out over 0.3 s (easeInOutCubic); the second row moves up 58 px into the first slot.

items.meaning: 滚动时背景层比内容移动得慢
items.ask: 让首屏背景以滚动距离的 0.3× 移动，形成视差滚动。
items.use: Use it to give the hero or a section photo a sense of depth.
spec: A browser window with a 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll: 0→120 px at 0.3–1.9 s, 120→0 at 2.9–4.3 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Each layer moves by scroll × factor: sky and sun 0.15, far hills 0.4, near hills 0.7.
Headline (28 px), button and the next section move at 1.0 (normal scrolling).
The next section (white) starts at the bottom of the hero (168 px) and slides over the slower background.
The scrollbar thumb on the right moves with the scroll.
items.aliases: 视差 滚动视差 背景慢移 滚动分层 parallax

items.meaning: 元素进入视口时逐渐出现
items.ask: 标题和卡片滚动进入视口时，从下方 30 px 在 0.6 s 内上移淡入。
items.use: Use it on a long landing page to bring content in piece by piece as the reader scrolls.
spec: Scroll: 0→95 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 95→200 px at 1.5–2.1 s, 200→0 at 3.2–4.4 s (all cubic ease-in-out).
Trigger line at 85% of the viewport height (143 px from the top). An element fires when its top edge passes above it (the Intersection Observer idea).
After firing, over 0.7 s: opacity 0→1 and offset 28 px below → 0 (cubic ease-out).
Three elements: the heading (172 px down the page), a row of three cards (206 px) and body text (334 px), all below the view at first. The cards in the row appear together.
When an element leaves the bottom of the view on the way back up, it is reset out of sight and plays again next time.
items.aliases: 滚动出现 上滑出现 进场 淡入 滚到就出现 fade up

items.meaning: 滚动时页头停留在屏幕顶部
items.ask: 把页头设为吸顶，到达顶部后加一层柔和阴影。
items.use: Use it to keep the menu and the call-to-action within reach on a long page.
spec: Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.4–1.3 s, 110→250 px at 1.9–2.8 s, 250→0 at 3.4–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
At the very top, a 22 px announcement strip (navy); below it a 34 px header (logo, three menu items, button).
Header position = max(22 − scroll, 0): once the strip is gone, it stops at the top edge (position: sticky; top: 0).
Over the next 24 px of scroll, a 12 px shadow under the header fades from 0 to 0.16 opacity.
The content (photo, heading, three cards) scrolls normally under the header.
items.aliases: 吸顶 悬浮导航 固定页头 顶部固定 sticky

items.meaning: 区块固定，滚动推动内部内容变化
items.ask: 固定三步骤区块，用户滚动时逐步切换照片和编号。
items.use: Use it to walk through steps, features or a before/after in one screen.
spec: Scroll: 0→500 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 500→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The section (168 tall, navy) reaches the top at 110 px of scroll and stays there for the next 300 px (a GSAP ScrollTrigger pin).
Progress while pinned: p = (scroll − 110) / 300. A vertical line (124 long) on the left fills in orange with p.
At p = 1/3 and 2/3 (±0.07, cubic ease-in-out) it moves to the next step: the number (46 px) rolls up 52 px and the photo (226 × 124) slides up 124 px.
After 300 px the pin is released and the section scrolls up with the white section below it.
items.aliases: 钉住 滚动配合 滚动钉住 pinned

items.meaning: 纵向滚动驱动内容横移
items.ask: 把作品区做成横向滚动：向下滚动多少，卡片就向左移动多少。
items.use: Use it to show work, case studies or products in a row inside a long vertical page.
spec: Scroll: 0→420 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 420→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The heading "WORKS" scrolls away; the section reaches the top at 40 px of scroll and stays there.
Cards: four at 200 × 112, gap 20, side padding 34. Horizontal travel = 34·2 + 200·4 + 20·3 − 511 = 417 px.
Card x = start x − p × 417, with p = (scroll − 40) / 380: linear in scroll, no easing.
The scrollbar thumb moves down while the cards move sideways.
items.aliases: 横滑 横向滚动 左右滚动 横排滚动 horizontal scroll

items.meaning: 滚动结束时自动对齐区块
items.ask: 让页面按区块滚动吸附，轻滚一下就落到下一节顶部。
items.use: Use it for a page that should read one full screen at a time, like slides.
spec: Each section is as tall as the viewport (168 px). The first is pale blue, the second navy.
One snap per 2.4 s. At 0.45–0.85 s the user scrolls only 34 px (cubic ease-out).
At 0.9–1.5 s the page moves the remaining 134 px by itself and lines up the next section's top (cubic ease-out).
The second 2.4 s does the same upward, back to the first section (the behaviour of scroll-snap-type: y mandatory).
items.aliases: 吸附 自动对齐 滚动对齐 snap

items.meaning: 顶部条显示阅读进度
items.ask: 文章顶部放 4 px 厚的品牌橙色滚动进度条。
items.use: Use it on long articles to show how much is left to read.
spec: The article scrolls 0→430 px in four 110 px steps, each moving for 0.45 s then pausing 0.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
It returns 430→0 at 3.75–4.55 s.
A 6 px bar along the top of the viewport: light grey track, orange fill.
Fill width = 511 px × scroll / 430, the scroll fraction itself (the same as CSS animation-timeline: scroll()).
items.aliases: 进度条 阅读进度 顶部进度 progress

items.meaning: 重点文字下方逐渐画出色带
items.ask: 关键词进入视口时，在下方用 0.8 s 从左向右画出黄色荧光标记。
items.use: Use it in landing-page copy to make the one phrase that matters stand out as it is read.
spec: Scroll: 0→90 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 90→180 px at 1.6–2.2 s, 180→0 at 3.3–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Two lines of copy (20 px, bold) at 190 px and 290 px down the page, hidden below the view at first.
When a line's top passes the trigger line (80% of the viewport height, 134 px), the stroke under its key words starts.
Stroke: yellow #FFE36B, 11 tall, in the lower part of the text (8 px above to 3 px below the baseline). Width 0 → word width from the left over 0.8 s (cubic ease-out), drawn behind the text.
Lines that leave the bottom of the view are reset out of sight.
items.aliases: 荧光笔 划线 高亮标记 画色带 马克笔 highlight

items.meaning: 悬停时元素抬高并加深阴影

items.use: Use it to make cards and buttons look clickable.

On hover the card rises 10 px over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over the same 0.3 s (like a CSS transition).
Shadow, changed together with the lift: blur 6→22 px, y offset 2→12 px, opacity 0.08→0.22.
Light grey page, white cards, so the shadow reads.

On hover the content scales 1→1.15 from the centre over 0.5 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over 0.5 s.
Anything outside the frame is clipped (overflow: hidden). The frame and the caption do not move.

items.meaning: 图形略带延迟地跟随指针

items.use: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to add a playful, hands-on feel.
spec: Cursor path: x = 255 + 175·sin(2πt/4.8), y = 86 + 46·sin(4πt/4.8) (a figure eight lying on its side, one lap per 4.8 s).
Circle: radius 17, orange, opacity 0.88, drawn under the cursor.
Follow rule: every frame (60 fps) it covers 12% of the remaining distance (x += (cursor x − x) × 0.12).
The arrow cursor stays visible.

items.meaning: 按钮向附近光标偏移

items.use: Use it on the one button you most want clicked, such as sign-up or contact.
spec: A 168 × 52 button (orange, radius 26) in the centre. The pull range is a 110 px radius from the button's centre.
Inside the range: target offset = (cursor − button centre) × 0.35; every frame (60 fps) the button covers 18% of the way to the target.
On leaving the range it returns from its current offset to 0 over 1.1 s with elastic.out(1, 0.3): 2^(−10x)·sin((x − 0.075)·2π/0.3) + 1.
The cursor enters from the left, circles the button and leaves to the right.

items.meaning: 从点击位置扩散的圆形波纹

The circle is centred on the click point; its radius grows from 0 to the distance to the button's farthest corner over 0.6 s (cubic ease-out).
White at 0.4 opacity, fading to 0 between 0.3 and 0.8 s after the click.
The circle is clipped to the button (overflow: hidden); the label sits above it.

Underline: orange, 3 thick, 8 px below the baseline.
On hover, width 0→100% from the left end over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out).

items.meaning: 拖动分隔线比较处理前后

Released at 3.62 s. Labels BEFORE (top left) and AFTER (top right).

Opens 0.05–0.45 s after firing (cubic ease-out): backdrop navy 0→0.5 opacity; popup (260 × 132, radius 12) opacity 0→1 and scale 0.9→1.
Inside: a heading, a discount line (orange), a coupon button and an × at the top right.

0→100% at 0.25–2.1 s (cubic ease-out, rounded to whole numbers); the bar fills in orange at the same rate.
At 2.3–2.85 s the whole screen moves up 168 px and out (cubic ease-in-out).
The page heading and photo fade in 0→1 and rise from 14 px below at 2.35–2.95 s (cubic ease-out).
At 4.25–4.75 s the screen comes back down from the top, at 0% (the next load).

Loading starts when a placeholder's top edge passes above the bottom of the viewport (168 px), with each column 0.12 s later than the one to its left.
For 0.45 s a spinner (radius 11, one turn per 0.8 s) turns in the placeholder's centre.
Then the image fades in 0→1 over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). Unloaded placeholders show an image icon.

Scroll: 38→116 px at 0.25–0.85 s, 116→194 px at 1.15–1.75 s (cubic ease-in-out); it stops with the end of the list in view.
At 2.6 s three items are added: each fades 0→1 and rises from 10 px below over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). The spinner moves to the new end.
Each cycle advances by three items (156 px). The content repeats every three items, so the end of the cycle looks the same as the start.

At 1.3 s, while covered, the page and the URL in the address bar (/works → /works/02) switch.

The panel covers the whole viewport, header included.

Once scroll passes 60 px, a round back-to-top button (radius 15) fades in over the next 40 px at the bottom right.

Orange (radius 230), light orange #FFB08F (210), blue (240), light blue #9DB6FB (200).

items.meaning: 持续摆动的波浪形区块分隔线
items.ask: 在首屏与下一节之间加入动态形状分隔线：叠放两层白色波浪，缓慢地反向持续摆动。
items.use: Use it where section edges should look soft rather than ruled, on sites about the sea, summer or children, for example.
spec: A 511 × 168 viewport: a blue gradient section on top (#3B64E8 → #8FA9F7) and a white section below, with two wave shapes layered at the boundary. One loop takes 4.7 s (two per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Back wave (white, opacity 0.45): centered at y = 100, the sum of a sine with wavelength 260 px, amplitude 8 px and one with wavelength 130 px, amplitude 4 px.
Front wave (white): centered at y = 110, wavelength 300 px / amplitude 9 px plus wavelength 110 px / amplitude 3.5 px; it runs into the white section below.

With phase a = 2π·t/4.7, the back wave uses a + 1 and −2a, the front wave −a and 2a + 0.5. The two sines in each wave run in opposite directions, so the shape keeps changing and returns to where it started every 4.7 s.
items.aliases: 波浪分隔 分隔线 摆动分隔 曲线分隔 divider

items.meaning: 点击后爱心迸发弹出
items.ask: 给帖子的点赞按钮加上点赞动画：点击后爱心填充红色并弹到 1.45×，周围散开小颗粒，数字加 1。
items.use: Use it on like, favorite or save buttons, to confirm the tap clearly and pleasantly.
spec: A 511 × 168 viewport: a post card with an outlined heart (line width 2.4) and the count "128" on the right. The heart is clicked at 0.9 s and clicked again at 3.3 s to undo. One pass takes 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
In the 0.1 s before the click it squeezes to 0.78×; at the click it fills red (#F23D5C), grows 0.78 → 1.45× in 0.12 s (cubic ease-out), then settles to 1× as 1 + 0.45·e^(−7t)·cos(15t).
0.08–0.58 s after the click: a red ring (radius 15 → 33, opacity 0.5 → 0) and six small particles in six directions (red, yellow, orange) flying out from radius 24 to 37 as they fade.
Count: 0.05–0.35 s after the click (cubic ease-out) 128 slides up and out and a red 129 comes in from below; undoing slides it back down to 128.
Undo: the heart goes back to an outline and dips to 0.84× and back over 0.4 s around the click (no particles).
items.aliases: 点赞 爱心 双击爱心 喜欢 like

items.meaning: 持续循环、引导向下滚动的动画
items.ask: 在首屏下方加入向下滚动提示：鼠标轮廓内的小圆点约每 1.5 s 向下移动并消失，循环播放。
items.use: Use it when the hero fills the screen and people need a hint that the page goes on below.
spec: A 511 × 168 viewport. Centered below the hero: "SCROLL" (11 px, 3 px letter spacing) and a mouse outline (24 × 38, radius 12, line width 2.2). One beat takes 1.57 s (three per 4.7 s, six per 9.4 s pack cycle).
The orange dot inside (5 × 9) drops 14 px over the first 70% of the beat (quadratic ease-in-out), fades out between 45% and 75%, and reappears at the top on the next beat.
40 px to each side, two down-chevrons (line width 2.5) per side, half a beat apart, drift 24 px downward; their opacity follows a sine, 0 → 0.8 → 0.
items.aliases: 下滑提示 滚动引导 往下滑 箭头提示 scroll down

items.meaning: 首屏背景中播放视频
items.ask: 首屏使用背景视频：静音循环播放，左侧叠加深色渐变，保证标题清晰可读。
items.use: Use it on hero sections for travel, hotels, restaurants or recruiting, where atmosphere and motion say more than one photo.
spec: A 511 × 168 viewport. Background footage (sky, clouds, mountains, sea) fills the hero, with a still headline (28 px, white) and button on top. The footage loops every 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Clouds: the far layer repeats every 170 px and moves 170 px right per 4.7 s (about 36 px/s); the near layer repeats every 340 px and moves 340 px per 4.7 s (about 72 px/s). The mountains stay still.

Sea: three waves (y = 118, 130, 146; amplitude 2.5–3 px; wavelength 90, 60, 120 px); only the middle one runs the other way and moves two wavelengths per 4.7 s (the other two move one wavelength to the right).
For legibility, a 12% navy layer covers the footage, a gradient darkens the left 300 px (opacity 0.45 → 0), and the headline has a shadow (10 px blur).
A playing badge (pause, muted) sits at the bottom right. On a real site the video uses autoplay, muted, loop and playsinline.
items.aliases: 视频背景 背景视频 首屏视频 background video

items.meaning: 相机整体垂直上下平移
items.ask: 保持镜头朝向不变，用垂直升降镜头从眼睛高度直线上升到约 3 m。
items.use: To show a shelf or a building from bottom to top smoothly, or to change the eye level without tilting.
spec: Camera: moves straight up from 1.0 m to 3.2 m; direction (yaw, pitch) and focal length (330 px) stay fixed
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead and slides down the frame, leaving at the bottom feet first; a tower stands 3.5 m right, 26 m away
Because the pitch does not change, the horizon stays at the centre of the frame (#031 Crane up tilts down while rising)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the height (↕ 1.0m → ↕ 3.2m)
items.aliases: 升降 上下平移 垂直移动 机位升高 pedestal

items.meaning: 相机绕镜头光轴旋转一整圈
items.ask: 让无人机画面用横滚镜头旋转一整圈，用时 3 s。
items.use: For aerial or drone footage that needs energy, or to show dizziness and confusion.
spec: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); roll only, 0 → 2π rad (360°); the whole picture turns around the frame centre
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; horizon, buildings and person all turn by the same angle, and white shows in the corners while turning
Hold: 3.6–4.2 s. After a full turn the picture equals the start, so the final 0.5 s cross-fade is invisible (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle (↻ 0° → ↻ 360°)
items.aliases: 横滚 翻滚 旋转一圈 镜头滚转 roll

items.meaning: 相机边移动边拍的延时摄影
items.ask: 拍一段从车站走到公园的移动延时：云朵流动，行人像快进一样移动。
items.use: To cover a long distance and a long stretch of time in one sweep through a city or a building.
spec: Camera: moves forward 0 m → 22 m (height 1.6 m, pitch +0.05 rad) while the sun, clouds and figures fast-forward through 12 hours (#039 Time-lapse keeps the camera still)
Timing: 0.4 s to 4.1 s (3.7 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Street: 12 buildings at x = ±7.5 m (5–55 m deep, 8–16 m tall) approach the camera and leave the frame

Sun: travels left to right along an arc, angle -1.25 rad → +1.25 rad, always 170 m ahead of the camera; three clouds drift 140 m right in total, wrapping every 80 m; six small figures cross an 11 m wide street
Building shadows fall away from the sun and swing as it moves (translucent grey); the mountains move with the camera so they keep their size
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the clock and the distance travelled (06:00 · 0m → 18:00 · 22m)
items.aliases: 移动延时 延时滑轨 走动延时 hyperlapse

items.meaning: 不切换，一个镜头连续拍到底
items.ask: 从准备到出发用一个长镜头拍完，跟着人物，中间不切镜头。
items.use: To keep tension and presence unbroken, or to show a sequence of movement as one flow.
spec: Join: none; for 4.2 s one shot keeps following the person (#041 Jump cut splits it into five)
Subject: a person walks at constant speed from front left (x = -3.4 m, 5.2 m deep) to back right (x = 2.8 m, 9.6 m deep); legs and arms swing by sin(t×7)×0.42 rad
Camera: trucks right 0 m → 1.4 m after the person while turning, yaw = atan2(person x - camera x, depth)×0.8; height 1.4 m
Bottom strip: one blue bar labelled "单镜头·不剪切" (one shot, no cut) with a playhead, showing there is no break
Return: stops at 4.2 s, then cross-fades back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the elapsed time (NO CUT 0.0s → 4.2s)
items.aliases: 一镜到底 长镜头 不切换 不剪 long take

items.meaning: 消除抖动，平稳流畅地移动
items.ask: 用斯坦尼康跟拍走廊里人物的背后，平稳无晃动。
items.use: To make a walking move look smooth and cinematic.
spec: Camera: moves forward at a constant 1.7 m/s (8 m per 4.7 s); height 1.45 m, pitch -0.02 rad; no easing
Sway: height ±3.5 cm (2 cycles per 4.7 s), sideways ±5 cm (1 cycle), yaw ±0.012 rad, roll ±0.006 rad, all sine waves with integer periods, slow and wide (#034 Handheld is fast and irregular)
Subject: a person walks 5 m ahead of the camera at the same speed; legs and arms take 5 strides per 4.7 s
Trees: 3.6 m tall at x = -5 m and 3.2 m tall at x = +5 m, every 8 m (the two rows offset by 4 m); the mountains and sun move with the camera
8 m is a multiple of the grid (2 m) and tree (8 m) spacing, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s; top-right readout shows "STEADICAM"
items.aliases: 稳定器 平稳移动 顺滑跟拍 云台 steadycam

items.meaning: 跟在主体身后移动
items.ask: 用背后跟拍拍摄在林中行走的人物背影，稍微落后一点跟着。
items.use: To enter a place together with a character, or for a third-person, game-like view.
spec: Path: the person walks the curve x = 1.8·sin(2.2s), depth z = 4 + 9s (s from 0 to 1), from 4 m to 13 m away
Camera: follows on the same curve at s-0.4 (about 3.6–3.9 m behind) and always faces the person, yaw = atan2(person x - camera x, person z - camera z); height 1.5 m
Timing: 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)); legs and arms swing by sin(s×30)×0.42 rad
The person stays near the centre of frame, seen from behind; posts and a rock beside the path sweep past in the foreground (#029 Tracking shot runs alongside)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows the distance to the person (FOLLOW 3.6–3.9m)
items.aliases: 背跟 身后跟拍 背影跟拍 后面跟着 walk and talk

items.meaning: 相机固定不动，只有主体移动
items.ask: 用固定镜头拍十字路口：相机固定在三脚架上，只有行人和车辆经过。
items.use: To make the subject stand out by contrast, for fixed-point observation, or as a base for time-lapse and compositing.
spec: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.4 m, facing forward, focal length 330 px); only the subjects move
Subject: a person crosses left to right at constant speed 6.5 m ahead (x = -6.2 m → +6.2 m in 4.7 s); legs and arms swing by sin(u×7)×0.42 rad
A grey car crosses right to left 15 m away (x = +16 m → -16 m in 4.7 s)
Both start and end outside the frame, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s
A grey tripod mark at bottom left; top-right readout shows "LOCKED" (#040 Freeze frame stops the footage time; here time runs and only the camera is still)
items.aliases: 固定机位 定点 机位不动 静静拍 static

items.meaning: 穿过窗户或门进入下一个空间
items.ask: 用穿越镜头从窗户进入房间，一直推到桌子上方。
items.use: To enter a building as an opening move, or to travel from one place to another in a single move.
spec: Camera: moves forward 0 m → 12.5 m (height 1.3 m, direction fixed); a wall with a window stands 8 m ahead and the camera passes through it
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Wall: a pale grey plane 80 m wide and 14 m tall with a window 2.4 m wide and 2.2 m tall (sill at 0.15 m); through it a person (0.3 m right, 14.5 m away), trees, buildings and mountains are visible
Pass-through: the wall stops being drawn 0.25 m in front of the camera; by then the window edge is outside the frame (half-width about 1580 px), so it vanishes unseen
After the pass the place beyond fills the frame and the camera closes to 2 m from the person (#035 FPV drone shot keeps weaving between trees)
Return: hold 3.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the distance to the window ("距窗户 8.0m" → "通过", passed)
items.aliases: 穿门 穿窗 穿越进入 钻过去

items.meaning: 从低处向上拍
items.ask: 英雄登场用低角度镜头，从贴近地面处向上拍。
items.use: To make a person look powerful or large, or to emphasise the height of a building.
spec: Camera: lowers from 1.5 m to 0.35 m while the pitch goes 0 → +0.32 rad (about 18° up); no movement forward or back
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 4.5 m ahead; an 11.8 m tower stands 3 m left, 22 m away. As the camera looks up, person and tower stretch upward and the horizon drops
Hold: stays at the low angle from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (time to read the composition itself)
Return: cross-fade back to eye level over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows angle and height (↗ 0° · 1.5m → ↗ 18° · 0.4m)
items.aliases: 仰拍 低角度 从下往上 显高大 low angle

items.meaning: 从高处向下拍
items.ask: 迷路孩子的场景用高角度镜头，从稍高处向下拍，让孩子显得很小。
items.use: To make a person look vulnerable or small, or to explain a situation from above.
spec: Camera: rises from 1.5 m to 4.5 m while the pitch goes 0 → -0.5 rad (about 29° down); no movement forward or back
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 5 m ahead; as the camera looks down they shrink and move lower, the ground grid fills most of the frame and the horizon leaves at the top
Hold: stays at the high angle from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (#031 Crane up keeps rising to 9 m; 13 Bird's-eye view looks straight down at 90°)
Return: cross-fade back to eye level over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows angle and height (↘ 0° · 1.5m → ↘ 29° · 4.5m)
items.aliases: 俯拍 高角度 从上往下 显渺小 high angle

items.meaning: 以角色的视线观看
items.ask: 开门走进房间的那一刻用 POV 镜头，以角色本人的视线拍摄。
items.use: To put the viewer in the character's place, or for a game-like or VR-like feel.
spec: Camera: walks forward 0 m → 3.2 m at the character's eye height of 1.6 m; 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Walking sway: height ±3 cm (6 cycles per 4.7 s), roll ±0.008 rad (3 cycles), added only while moving
Hands: blue rounded hands at both bottom corners (±178 px from centre), a white phone in the right one; they move with the body, so the hands stay still and the world sways
The other person, 7.5 m ahead, raises both arms and waves only from 1.6 s to 3.4 s (looking at you); two posts in the foreground
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows "POV"
items.aliases: 第一人称 主观视角 眼睛视角 POV

items.meaning: 越过一人的肩膀拍另一人
items.ask: 对话用过肩镜头拍摄，前景的肩膀稍微虚化。
items.use: To show who is facing whom in a conversation and to focus on the other person's expression.
spec: Framing: the back of the foreground person's head and shoulder (grey, 0.62 m left, 1.15 m away) fill the left edge; the other person (blue, 0.32 m right, 3.1 m away) is seen past the shoulder
Focus: the foreground shoulder is blurred 2.6 px, the other person is sharp and framed from the chest up
Camera: height 1.55 m, yaw +0.05 rad; pushes in slowly 0 m → 0.35 m from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
The other person sways arms and legs by 0.35·sin(u×5) rad, as if talking
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "OTS"
items.aliases: 过肩 越肩拍 对话镜头 over shoulder

items.meaning: 从正上方垂直向下拍
items.ask: 从正上方用鸟瞰镜头拍十字路口，人和车以从上往下看的样子移动。
items.use: To show layout and paths like a diagram, or for a god's-eye overview.
spec: Camera: points straight down (pitch -π/2 = -90°) and rises from 9 m to 15 m, directly above the origin
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Ground: a 2 m grid and a 3.2 m wide road (white dashed centre line) drawn as one plane; six trees as circles and three buildings as squares, seen from above
Subjects: a person (head circle and shoulder ellipse) walks 5.2 m up the right side of the road, a car (1.8×4 m) drives 6.8 m down the left side; both move in proportion to the progress p
As the camera rises everything shrinks and more of the ground comes into view (10 High angle looks down at a slant)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "↓ 90° · 9m → 15m"
items.aliases: 鸟瞰 航拍 俯视 上帝视角 顶视 aerial

items.meaning: 从近处到远处全部清晰
items.ask: 前景的杯子和后方的人物都要清晰，所以用深焦镜头。
items.use: When the viewer may look anywhere in the frame, or to show several things happening at different depths at once.
spec: Camera: position, direction and focal length all fixed (height 1.1 m); only the blur amounts change

Blur: the foreground flower (0.75 m left, 2 m away) goes 5 px → 0 px and the background (person 0.9 m right, 9 m away; buildings; mountains) goes 6 px → 0 px, both sharpening together (#033 Rack focus blurs one side)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Focus markers: blue corner brackets on both the flower (half-width 46 px) and the person (half-width 30 px), opacity 0 → 1 as focus arrives
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the aperture (f/1.8 → f/16)
items.aliases: 全景清晰 深焦 前后都清楚 deep focus

items.meaning: 开场交代地点的远景
items.ask: 开头先用能看到整个城镇的定场镜头，同时显示地名。
items.use: At the start of a scene to say where we are, or whenever the place or time changes.
spec: Camera: wide lens (focal length 220 px, shown as 16mm), height 4.5 m, pitch -0.06 rad; pushes in slowly from -5 m to -2.5 m
Timing: 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Scene: eight city buildings 30 m away, a tower 16 m right and 36 m away, three clouds and mountains; a small person 1 m left, 12 m away gives the scale
Location caption: from 0.9 s to 1.3 s a white card reading "EXT. CITY – DAY" (158×30 px, blue bar on its left) fades in at bottom left while moving up 8 px, then stays
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows "16mm WIDE"
items.aliases: 交代环境 开场远景 定场 空镜 establishing

items.meaning: 只放大眼睛或指尖等局部
items.ask: 眼泪落下的瞬间，用只拍眼睛的大特写。
items.use: For the emotional peak, or to make the viewer notice one small detail.
spec: Camera: the face's right eye (0.06 m left of centre, 1.66 m high) 1.3 m ahead is placed at the centre of frame; the camera does not move
Focal length: 610 px → 2040 px (shown as 44mm → 148mm, about 3.3×); f = 610 × (2040/610)^p, where p is a cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)) from 0.5 s to 3.4 s

Face: a blue head (radius 0.16 m) with white eyes (ellipses 0.045×0.028 m), dark pupils (radius 0.016 m), highlights and white brows; it starts as a close-up of the whole face (head about 150 px across) and ends with only the eyes filling the frame
Background: trees and buildings blurred 3 px, leaving the frame as the lens closes in
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the focal length and the abbreviation (44mm CU → 148mm ECU)
items.aliases: 特写 局部特写 眼睛特写 手指特写 extreme close up

items.meaning: 插入同一场景中的细节
items.ask: 转动钥匙时用插入镜头拍手部特写，然后马上切回。
items.use: To show a small object or a hand action, or to point out an important prop.
spec: Join: two straight cuts (0 frames); to the detail at 1.6 s and back to the scene at 2.9 s (the detail lasts 1.3 s)
Main shot (A): fixed camera (height 1.4 m); a person stands 0.6 m left, 6 m away, with a watch (dark dot) on the wrist; a post 2.2 m right, 4 m away

Detail (INSERT): a big close-up of the wrist from the same scene; a blue sleeve (600×92 px, rotated -0.35 rad) on pale blue, a white dial (radius 58 px), dark hands and a blue second hand that makes one turn in 1.3 s
Bottom strip: three sections A (grey), detail (blue), A (grey) with a playhead; what is cut in belongs to the same scene (21 Cutaway shows a different subject)
Top-right readout shows "SHOT A" → "INSERT" → "SHOT A"; at 4.7 s it cuts straight back to the start
items.aliases: 空镜 细节插入 补镜 插入画面 insert

items.meaning: 平滑衔接相同构图的两段画面
items.ask: 用变形剪切去掉采访中说错重来的部分，让接缝看不出来。
items.use: To tighten an interview or narration, or to remove a slip without drawing attention.
spec: Take 1 (0–2.0 s): fixed camera (height 1.45 m); the person stands 0.4 m left, 3.3 m away, arms and legs at -0.45 rad. Take 2 (from 2.45 s): 0.35 m right, +0.55 rad. Both sway slightly by 0.12·sin(t×3) rad

Morph (2.0–2.45 s, 0.45 s): the position is interpolated with a quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)), and the two poses are drawn at the same interpolated position and cross-faded
Only during the morph a blur of sin(q×π)×2.2 px is applied to the whole frame to soften the join (#041 Jump cut lets the position jump)
Bottom strip: take 1 (grey), morph (blue, narrow), take 2 (grey) with a playhead
Return: cross-fade back to the start of take 1 over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "TAKE 1" → "MORPH" → "TAKE 2"
items.aliases: 无缝衔接 同构图切 变形过渡 morph cut

items.meaning: 画面逐渐变暗直至全黑
items.ask: 场景结尾用 1 s 淡出到黑场，下一场景再从黑场中淡入。
items.use: For a chapter break, a long passage of time, or the end of a story.
spec: Fade out: from 1.4 s to 2.6 s (1.2 s) black (rgb(20,20,24)) is laid over the outgoing picture with opacity 0 → 100%, quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1))

items.ask: 为报名线上英语课的人做一张客户旅程地图：分 5 个阶段写出行为和心情，用一条线表示心情起伏。
items.use: To see what customers do at each stage and where their mood drops.
spec: Frame: five columns with vertical dividers; the stage headers on top are plain rounded boxes (not arrows; the middle one gray), appearing from 0.35 s, 0.1 s apart
Actions: a white card under each header (text as gray bars), rising 8 px while it appears over 0.3 s, from 0.6 s, 0.1 s apart
Feeling: against a dotted neutral line at y = 150, a smooth blue curve (3.5 px) through +0.35, +0.7, −0.6, +0.15 and +0.85 (× 36 px) is drawn from left to right between 1.25 s and 2.25 s
Marks: as the line reaches each point a face (radius 12 px) pops in: a blue smile above the neutral line, a gray frown below it
There are no arrows across lanes (unlike #238 Swimlane diagram)
End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
items.aliases: 旅程地图 用户旅程 触点 体验地图 journey map

items.meaning: 用方块大小表示整体的构成
items.ask: 用矩形树图展示按商品划分的销售额构成：方块大小对应销售额，最大的商品用深蓝色。
items.use: To show at a glance how much of the whole each part takes up.
spec: Frame: a 439×172 px dashed outline (6 px dash, 6 px gap); it stays for the whole cycle
Rectangles: seven, with 5 px corners: the large A on the left (206×172 px, dark blue), then B (140×96 px), C, D and three small ones; dark blue, mid blue, light blue, gray
Motion: from 0.4 s, 0.22 s apart, each grows from 0.55× to full size over 0.4 s with an overshoot (ease-out-back) while fading in
Labels: letters at the top-left of A–D (A in 24 px white, the others 20 px)
End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
items.aliases: 树图 方块占比 面积占比 treemap

items.packZh: 资料中常用的图解与图表名称
items.meaning: 按负责人分泳道排列步骤
items.ask: 用泳道图画出从咨询到交付的流程：分成客户、销售、制作 3 条泳道，用箭头连接各步骤。
items.use: To show who does what, and when, in a process shared by several people or teams.
spec: Lanes: three white lanes 60 px tall, with gray lane names (18 px) in a 62 px column on the left; they stay for the whole cycle

Boxes: five 56×30 px rounded boxes from x = 138 to 474, in the lanes customer → sales → production → sales → customer, popping in over 0.28 s (ease-out-back) from 0.4 s, 0.38 s apart; the last one dark blue
Arrows: from the right edge of the previous box, across and then up or down into the next (dark gray, 2.5 px, 9 px head), growing over 0.26 s from 0.24 s before each box
Unlike #233 Gantt chart: no date scale; the lane names and the arrows crossing lanes carry it
End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
items.aliases: 泳道 跨部门流程 分角色 责任分工 swimlane

items.packZh: 资料中常用的图解与图表名称
items.meaning: 横向排列箭头形状的步骤
items.ask: 用 V 形流程图展示 5 天培训的安排：横向排 5 个箭头，每个下面写两行内容。
items.use: To show steps that follow each other, such as a training schedule or a rollout, in one row.
spec: Shape: five chevrons 104 px wide and 74 px tall (point depth 24 px, 6 px gaps); from the second on, the left side is notched to fit the one before
Colors: light blue, light blue, mid blue, mid blue, dark blue, with the numbers 1–5 (24 px) in the middle
Motion: from 0.4 s, 0.3 s apart, each slides in from 34 px to the left over 0.42 s while fading in (ease-out)
Notes: two gray bars (62 px and 44 px long) under each step, fading in over 0.3 s from 0.25 s after the step starts
End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
items.aliases: V型 箭头流程 步骤条 箭头串联 chevron

items.packZh: 资料中常用的图解与图表名称
items.meaning: 用嵌套的圆逐层缩小市场范围
items.ask: 用同心圆图展示线上学习的市场规模：从外到内分为 TAM、SAM、SOM 三层，并写上金额。
items.use: To show how you narrow down from the whole to the part you target, as in TAM, SAM and SOM.
spec: Circles: filled circles of radius 91, 61 and 31 px on one center (light blue, mid blue, dark blue from the outside), with a faint gray guide ring for the outer circle that stays
Motion: from the outer circle in, 0.45 s apart (0.4, 0.85, 1.3 s), each grows from the center over 0.5 s, a 60:40 blend of ease-out and ease-out-back for a slight overshoot
Labels: TAM and SAM in the bands between the circles, SOM in the inner circle (18 px), fading in over 0.3 s from 0.55 s after each circle starts
Unlike #217 Venn diagram: the circles are nested, not set side by side
End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
items.aliases: 同心圆 嵌套圆 市场圈 目标圈 TAM SAM SOM
